scope: Typography, simulated ink coverage and shared paper illumination. No research photograph or simulator font is included in the plugin.

local_simulator.name: 手写模拟器 v2.2
local_simulator.finding: Readable configuration controls spacing and per-glyph perturbation. No lighting control found there. The executable source was not available; no claim about its internal rendering implementation.

references.title: High-resolution Document Shadow Removal / SD7K, ICCV 2023
references.use: Inspected photographed printed and handwritten documents in the visualization figures. Broad shadows vary paper and ink together; letter edges remain locally detailed.

references.title: Canadian Conservation Institute: Lighting Techniques for Photographing Heritage Objects
references.use: Raking light reveals surface relief, creases and damage; diffuse light reduces this contrast.

references.title: Yale: Visible Light Imaging
references.use: Diffuse illumination and consistent light falloff across a document, avoiding conflicting shadows.

implementation.material: Deterministic subpixel ink coverage, very mild optical softening, multiplicative ink on existing paper; existing crease displacement and abrasion remain.
implementation.light: Diffuse, top-left window light and soft diagonal shade; shadows and reflected light cover both paper and all marks, masked by the paper alpha silhouette. Crease relief uses the same coordinates as the displaced ink.
implementation.limitation: Art-directed 2D approximation; the generated paper already contains baked-in texture and lighting. This is not physically based 3D relighting.
